warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE D180 Known Issue: Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your XE D180 is an X760 generation model with the AJ200D diesel engine, timing chain and injector seal wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine. We replace the timing chain, injectors, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

Not all XE variants share this issue - it applies to the diesel range, including the D180, D150, and D240. The petrol Ingenium and V6 supercharged variants use different engine designs without the same consistently reported pattern.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages per VRF-jaguar-xe.md.
